name: Google Drive

tiers.how: New Drive documents from the owner's accounts are pulled hourly into `Raw/Drive/` by `scripts/drive_ingest/`, then promoted to wiki notes via wiki-ingest. The owner must authorize the Drive API scope in the OAuth consent flow and keep the scheduled Drive ingest task running. The ingest is read-only and append-only to `Raw/Drive/`.
writes: nothing; Drive ingest is strictly read-only
always_tap: any file upload or share initiated on behalf of the owner

tiers.how: For uploads, share-permission changes, or anything the API cannot do headlessly, Sage drives Drive in a signed-in Playwright browser. The owner must confirm the browser profile is logged into the correct Google account before the task runs.
reads: anything visible in the Drive web UI

gotchas: Drive ingest is append-only into `Raw/Drive/`; never edit or delete raw source files.
The hourly ingest may lag up to 60 minutes; do not rely on it for real-time document availability.
Sharing or uploading client files always requires explicit owner approval.
The Drive API scope must be added to the existing OAuth token; re-consent may be required.
notes: Google Drive is a read-only source for the wiki knowledge base; the hourly ingest pipeline in `scripts/drive_ingest/` handles promotion to wiki notes.
